title: 2012 SAGE Hit Red #3 Michael Floyd Notre Dame Fighting Irish
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 SAGE Hit sports trading card features Michael Floyd, the Notre Dame Fighting Irish football player. The card is a single-parallel, red version, and is numbered 3. It is a rookie card and was manufactured by SAGE in 2012. The card is an original and not a reprint. 

The card attributes include the player's name, set, type, season, card number, and card manufacturer. The card features the athlete's rookie status and is a great addition to any football fan's collection. This trading card is perfect for those who want to own a piece of sports history.
